title: PRC-linked abuse: Surveillance and influence activity
summary: OpenAI banned PRC-linked accounts using AI to support surveillance-related planning, targeted profiling, and research on critics and other individuals.
body: OpenAI banned PRC-linked accounts using AI to support surveillance-related planning, targeted profiling, and research on critics and other individuals.
summaryZh: OpenAI披露并封禁了一批与中国相关联的账户，这些账户涉嫌利用人工智能技术支持监控相关规划、针对性画像以及针对批评者和其他个人的研究活动，反映了大模型在现实地缘政治与安全合规领域面临的持续威胁。原始信息显示：OpenAI banned PRC-linked accounts using AI to support surveillance-related planning, targeted profiling, and research on critics and other individuals.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“PRC-linked abuse: Surveillance and influence activity”。其重要性主要体现在：该报告揭示了AI大模型在现实中被用于监控和情报搜集的滥用情况，对安全合规具有警示意义。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
